"Ingredients:

1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened

1/2 cup mayonnaise

1/2 cup sour cream

1 (2.25 ounce) can sliced ripe olives, drained

1 (4 ounce) can chopped ripe olives, drained

1 (4 ounce) can chopped pimento, drained

1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix

1 (10 ounce) package frozen puff pastry, thawed

Directions:

Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, sliced olives, chopped olives, pimento, and onion soup mix.

Unfold the puff pastry sheets, and cut each into 12 squares. Place a heaping teaspoon of the cream cheese mixture in the center of each square. Fold the corners of the square over the filling, and pinch the edges together to seal. Place the spirals on a baking sheet, and bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown. Serve warm."
